zh.text: 麻省理工学院是位于美国马萨诸塞州剑桥市的私立研究型大学，成立于1861年。学校最初在波士顿采用欧洲理工模式，侧重应用科学与工程学的实验教学。1916年，校区迁至查尔斯河北岸，主校区沿河延伸，以现代主义建筑和相互连通的走廊为特色。学院设有六间学术学院，涵盖工程、基础科学、社会科学及人文学科。其校外运营包括林肯实验室和Haystack天文台等机构。

en.text: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology is a private research university located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, established in 1861. Initially organized in Boston, it adopted a polytechnic model emphasizing laboratory instruction in applied science and engineering. In 1916, the institute moved to its current campus along the Charles River, featuring interconnected academic buildings and significant modernist architecture. The university comprises six academic schools covering engineering, basic sciences, social sciences, and humanities. Its off-campus operations include the MIT Lincoln Laboratory and the Haystack Observatory.
